people.name: Brook_of_Egypt
people.line: Southwestern boundary of the Promised Land

people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.
translations.bsb: In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt, and you, O Israelites, will be gathered one by one.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
translations.asv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Jehovah will beat off his fruit from the flood of the River unto the brook of Egypt; and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
